title: Venezuelan War of Independence
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Venezuelan War of Independence", at revision 1376108556, opens: "The Venezuelan War of Independence was one of the Spanish American wars of independence of the early nineteenth century, when independence movements in South America fought a civil war for secession and against unity of the Spanish Empire, emboldened by Spain's troubles in the Napoleonic Wars." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q8934, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Venezuelan section of the Spanish American war of independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
